group: How much of each market is owned from abroad
title: How much of Türkiye's debt securities is owned from abroad: non-residents and residents, in its own currency
short: Türkiye debt securities, owned from abroad
source: OECD financial balance sheets, non-consolidated, quarterly (DSD_NASEC20@DF_T720R_Q), Türkiye (TUR): issued by residents (sector S1, liabilities) and held by non-residents (S2, assets), debt securities (F3), national currency; residents = issued minus non-residents (our calculation). The opinions expressed and arguments employed in this adaptation should not be reported as representing the official views of the OECD or of its Member countries
note: Each book splits everything residents of Türkiye have issued of debt securities into the part held by non-residents, as the country reports it to the OECD, and the rest, held by residents (our calculation: issued minus non-residents), in its own currency and at market value. Non-residents means every holder outside the country, including foreign central banks and funds. It does not say which kind of resident holds the rest, which needs the country's own accounts. Source: OECD.
